title: Stripes are not a good look
signal: Beech leaf disease, tied to an invasive nematode, now reaches 15 states and Ontario. Fluopyram and trunk injections can save individual trees, but no forest-scale treatment exists yet.

signal: New Mexico's 2025 aerial survey found tree deaths tripled statewide and beetle-killed conifer acres rose 211%, mostly on national forests, as drought, heat and warm winters stressed overly dense stands.

primary.text: Drought-weakened, overstocked stands fall to bark beetles faster than crews can thin or replant.
